en.name: Remote Desktop
en.description: View and control your Mac and Windows computers. Optional component, view-only mode, temporary pairing codes and instant disconnect. LAN or Tailscale; audio, lock screens and public relay are not included yet.

zh.name: 远程桌面
zh.description: 连接同一工作区的 Mac 与 Windows，实时查看画面、操作键盘和鼠标。远控组件按需安装，默认关闭；支持仅查看、临时配对码与随时断开。首版用于局域网或 Tailscale，不含声音、锁屏登录和公网中继。
